scope: Spline pion DC edges tight, 3D Bayesian only, on a copy of fits/spline/dcfid_pip/tight/fit_copy.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: manual. start=auto: the 3D spline B windows for these 452 histograms have median width 0.0153 and 428 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.0070 with 445 narrower than 0.05, so those windows can pin a fit. The run-local guide started as Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_Initialize.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 refit all 452 histograms with the manual baseline and opened 65 keys whose own cosine was outside the manual window or whose stored curve missed that cosine. Pass 2 put starts on 13 histograms the half-width second pass had driven off that cosine, and refit Q2-y 1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 10, 11, 13, and 14. Unselected Q2-y bins stayed at the pass-1 result. JSON still has 452 bins. (1, 8) moved off the pinned B=-0.045 onto this histogram's cosine. The nominal B was not imposed.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Bins were not pulled toward the nominal or a neighbor. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) keeps B=-0.143971 rather than the nominal B=-0.125184 because these points support the larger modulation. Four bins still have a cos(2phi) error that collapses because the amplitude is consistent with zero: (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_1), (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_14), (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_13), and (Q2_y_Bin_11)-(z_pT_Bin_7). The free cosine does not change those shapes, so the limits were not opened again. The collapsed errors are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and they are not added to the systematic budget.
unresolved: The remaining high chi-squared is the histogram shape. The retained A(1+B cos phi+C cos 2phi) already matches an unconstrained cosine, so another guide change would not help. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_14) 6.094 (chi2 127.974, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_7) 6.094 (chi2 127.971, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) 5.928 (chi2 124.496, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_10) 5.592 (chi2 117.428, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_12) 5.061 (chi2 106.274, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_6)-(z_pT_Bin_6) 4.973 (chi2 94.483, NDF 19); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_2) 4.961 (chi2 59.528, NDF 12); (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_6) 4.710 (chi2 84.788, NDF 18); (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_5) 4.547 (chi2 77.304, NDF 17); (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_2) 4.534 (chi2 68.008, NDF 15); (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_12) 4.407 (chi2 92.542, NDF 21); (Q2_y_Bin_9)-(z_pT_Bin_14) 4.390 (chi2 92.186, NDF 21). (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is not unresolved as a guide miss: the retained curve matches the free cosine, and the remaining chi-squared is scatter inside 60-300. Isolated spikes that the cosine cannot absorb: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) pull 9.59 at 352 deg, fraction 0.74; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_26) pull 6.15 at 352 deg, fraction 0.47; (Q2_y_Bin_14)-(z_pT_Bin_12) pull 5.87 at 352 deg, fraction 0.45; (Q2_y_Bin_9)-(z_pT_Bin_14) pull -5.76 at 112 deg, fraction 0.36. No empty histograms.
why_retained: The final pass is kept because every histogram chi-squared is at least as low as the stored fit, aside from a 0.0009 numerical change on (Q2_y_Bin_10)-(z_pT_Bin_17), 36 are lower by more than 0.5, and the curves follow each histogram's own cosine. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is no longer pinned at B=-0.045. The nominal value was not imposed. The overlay in overlays/tight_final.png shows the retained curve on the points and the stored curve. Fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic uncertainty. Histogram bin contents match the source file.
